subject: Issue with running inla in Linux

messages.author: b5fda5cbd8cef35d
messages.subject: Issue with running inla in Linux
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to run rinla on the cluster. I've downloaded INLA package and used the inla.binary.install() for a Linux alternative. But when I tested a simple code

library(INLA)
y= rnorm(10)
df= data.frame(Y=y)
mod= inla(Y~1,family="gaussian", data =df)

I got the following error.

/home/njayaweera/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.3/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl: /home/njayaweera/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.3/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/first/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.30' not found (required by /cm/shared/spack/opt/spack/linux-ubuntu20.04-x86_64/gcc-12.1.0/icu4c-67.1-ol3mpxfu6gaa22lxnsoukci7yv6gpgb6/lib/libicuuc.so.67)
/home/njayaweera/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.3/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl: /home/njayaweera/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.3/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/first/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.30' not found (required by /cm/shared/spack/opt/spack/linux-ubuntu20.04-x86_64/gcc-12.1.0/icu4c-67.1-ol3mpxfu6gaa22lxnsoukci7yv6gpgb6/lib/libicuuc.so.67)
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()

I used the same program in my Windows laptop/desktop, and it worked without any error. I believe this might be due to Linux or gcc version?  I would be very grateful if you could help me on this matter. 

Thank you! Appreciate your help.

Best,
Nadeesha
